newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends firmer, off highs as Dow dips.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends firmer, off highs as Dow dips.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 share index edged closer to its record peak, lifted by a buoyant bank sector.
The leading blue chip index finished 19.8 points higher at 4,681.6, just 12.3 points off its all-time closing high set on May 16.
But trading volume was light, with many dealings rooms thinned out on the back of the long holiday weekend. By 1535 GMT, SEAQ volume registered only 536.4 million shares.
Also, gains were not broad based. FTSE 100 decliners narrowly outpacing advancers 50 to 44.
